subject: prd/impl-review
statement: Review harness selection remains the invoking configuration's explicit upstream decision; review-role routing never scans installed CLIs, switches harnesses, or reuses an implementation-role native decision implicitly.
rationale: credentials, availability, and egress policy are not capacity decisions; role mappings differ
fit_criterion: exact, promoted, unsupported, and kill-switch fixtures retain the same selected review harness and independently resolve the review role
